title: Capture consequential exceptions, not every possible fact
text: The CMR source note describes identifying critical expertise and making context-dependent reasoning visible through cases and exceptions. The practical opportunity is to prioritise knowledge that repeatedly changes important decisions, rather than launch an indiscriminate document-everything programme.
qualification: Practitioner article represented in analytical notes, not proof that all tacit knowledge can be fully codified.
